Docs.summary: Provides types that describe problems detected by Android StrictMode.

remarks.para: The violation types describe detected thread-policy and virtual machine policy problems, such as disk access, network access, and resource leaks. Configure detection and penalties through . A violation type does not by itself specify whether the application logs the problem or terminates.
StrictMode is a diagnostic tool, not a security mechanism. Detection is not guaranteed to find every problem. See the Android StrictMode reference for policy configuration and detection limits.
